question: National Coal Development Corporation (NCDC) was formed in ______ with 11 collieries with the task of exploring new coalfields and expediting development of new coal mines.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1957**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **National Coal Development Corporation (NCDC)** was established as a **Government of India** undertaking in **1957** (incorporated in **September 1956** and operationalized in **1957**) with the specific goal of increasing coal production in the public sector.
 
• At the time of its formation, the corporation was handed over the management of **11** state-owned collieries which were originally under the control of the **Indian Railways**.
 
• The primary task assigned to the **NCDC** was to explore **new coalfields** and expedite the development of **new coal mines** to meet the heavy energy demands of the **Second Five-Year Plan**.
